payment.prompt: What payment methods do you accept?

responses.greeting: Hello! Great to meet you. I'm here to make your shopping at Diba Gallery easier — ask about products, delivery, returns, or anything else on your mind.
responses.shipping: We deliver across Iran with careful packaging for furniture and décor. Standard delivery usually takes 3–7 business days in major cities; remote areas may take a little longer. You'll receive tracking details by SMS once your order ships. Need help with a specific order? Share your order number with our support team.
responses.returns: We want you to love every piece. Most unused items in original packaging can be returned within 7 days of delivery. Custom or made-to-order pieces may have different terms — I'll flag those on product pages. Refunds are processed within 5–10 business days after we receive and inspect the return.
responses.orders: You can track orders from your account dashboard under Orders. Each order shows its current status — confirmed, preparing, shipped, or delivered. If you checked out as a guest, use the tracking link in your confirmation email or contact support with your phone number.
responses.recommend: I'd love to help you find the right piece! For a warm living room, consider a hand-knotted wool rug in neutral tones, layered with textured cushions from our home collection. Browse Rugs & Textiles, or tell me your room size, style (modern, classic, minimal), and budget — I'll narrow it down further.
responses.payment: We accept online card payments, bank transfers, and instalments on eligible orders. At checkout you'll see all available options for your cart total. Payments are processed securely — we never store your full card details.
responses.hours: Our support team is available Saturday to Thursday, 9:00–18:00. You can reach us via the Contact page, live chat during business hours, or visit a store branch. I'm available anytime for general shopping guidance.
responses.fallback: That's a great question. I can help with product recommendations, shipping, returns, order tracking, and payment options. Could you tell me a bit more about what you're looking for? For personal account issues, our human support team can help during business hours.
